tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search EveryHourDeal's US catalog (furniture, patio, grills, home gym, e-bikes, appliances, pets and more). Every item ships free from a US warehouse with 30-day returns. Returns name, price (USD), link, image and delivery days.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2-5 EveryHourDeal products side by side (price, highlights, delivery days); says which is cheapest and fastest.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one EveryHourDeal product by id (from search_products).

tools.name: deal_of_the_hour
tools.description: The product featured as EveryHourDeal's Deal of the Hour right now, and when the next one starts.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: EveryHourDeal's departments and how many products each has.
